description: Build Home screen with green gradient header, week date selector, stats cards, task list, and floating add button. Header shows greeting and horizontal scrollable week dates. Stats show Total/Completed/Pending counts. Task list shows each task with title, category badge, deadline, checkbox, edit, delete buttons.
steps: Create src/components/week-date-selector.tsx: horizontal ScrollView with current week dates (Mon 20, Tue 21, etc.), calculate dates for current week, highlight selected date, use GreenTheme colors

Create src/components/task-item.tsx: single task row component accepting Task prop and onToggle/onEdit/onDelete callbacks, displays title, category badge (Personal/School with green background), deadline formatted, checkbox using Pressable, edit icon button, delete icon button, follows ThemedView pattern

Create src/components/add-task-modal.tsx: Modal with TextInput for title, two buttons for category selection (Personal/School), TextInput for deadline (placeholder 'YYYY-MM-DD'), toggle switch for priority, Submit button closes modal and calls onSubmit callback with new task data, Cancel button, green theme styling

Create src/app/(tabs)/home.tsx: green gradient header View (backgroundColor with GreenTheme.gradientStart since expo-linear-gradient not installed), greeting text 'Good day, Van! One small task at a time is still progress', WeekDateSelector component, white background section with 3 stat cards (View components) showing totalCount/completedThisWeek/pendingCount from useTasks hook, FlatList of tasks using TaskItem component, floating Pressable button (green circle with + text) positioned bottom-right above tab bar using absolute positioning, useState for modal visibility and selected task for editing, integrate useTasks hook for data and operations
acceptance_criteria: Home screen renders with all sections: header, week selector, stats, task list, add button
Header displays green background with greeting and week dates
Stats cards show correct counts from useTasks
Task list displays all tasks with proper formatting
Add modal accepts input and creates new task
Edit button opens modal with existing task data
verification: Run `npx expo start` and navigate to Home tab
Verify all UI elements render correctly
findings: All acceptance criteria met. Created WeekDateSelector component with horizontal scrolling week dates (Sun-Sat format) and selection highlighting. Created TaskItem component displaying task title, category badge (Personal/School with green styling), formatted deadline, completion checkbox, and edit/delete action buttons with confirmation dialog. Created AddTaskModal using React key prop pattern to properly reset state between add/edit modes - modal includes title input, category selection buttons, deadline input (YYYY-MM-DD format), priority toggle switch, and submit/cancel buttons. Built complete Home screen with green header (backgroundColor using GreenTheme.gradientStart), greeting text, WeekDateSelector integration, 3 stat cards showing totalCount/completedThisWeek/pendingCount from useTasks hook, FlatList with TaskItem components, and floating add button positioned bottom-right with absolute positioning (bottom: BottomTabInset + 20). All CRUD operations integrated: add task, edit task (pre-populates modal), delete task (with confirmation), toggle completion. TypeScript compilation passes. Linting passes for all new files (pre-existing lint error in src/hooks/use-color-scheme.web.ts is unrelated to this feature). Committed as 'feat: build Home screen with stats, task list, and add modal (FEAT-004)'.
